messages:
Maria: quick heads up — I'm swapping primary to @AJ at 18:00 UTC. I'm on a flight (ETA wifi patchy) so AJ will take pager and lead on the embeds latency incident while I'm out. I'll stay reachable for 15m for handoff.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: EMBEDS_HIGH_LATENCY (sev2) — 2m ago. Links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-3487

Sam: seeing increased 5xx from the embeddings endpoint, approx 25-35% error rate. Oncall logs show tail latency spikes ~2s -> 10s.

AJ: I can take primary. I'll be at my desk at 18:00 UTC. Can you drop the quick runbook notes here before you go?

Maria: yup. TL;DR runbook: https://runbooks.internal/embeds-latency — main mitigation is to bounce embed-cache and shift traffic to embed-fallback model for low-latency routes. Quick commands below:

```
# restart cache service (namespace: inference)
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/embed-cache
# check pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embed-cache -o wide
# temporary routing: set route tag to fallback model
redwoodctl routes set embeds --model embed-fallback-v1 --weight 30
```

Maria: if you need to escalate to infra, paging policy is in runbook (bottom). If bounce doesn't help in 10m, escalate to infra-sre and open a debug session.

oncall-bot: Update: Status changed to INVESTIGATING by Maria (2498765454).

Nora: FYI — we have a scheduled infra deploy at 18:20 UTC that could overlap. If AJ is primary, suggest holding that deploy to avoid noisy restart during mitigation. @deploy-bot flagged it in calendar.

AJ: good call. I'll request a 30m hold on the infra deploy. Also I'll take the pager now; Maria, if you don't make it to the gate before 18:00 I'll assume handoff.

Maria: confirmed. Requested hold on deploy and posted reason in #eng-releases. Also left a short checklist: 1) try restart, 2) reroute 30% traffic, 3) monitor errors for 5m, 4) escalate if no improvement.

Sam: after bumping traffic to fallback (did that locally), error rate dropped to ~8% and avg latency down to ~450ms. Looks promising.

AJ: I'm doing the rollout to set fallback 30% -> 50% and will monitor. Will stand by to initiate cache restart if errors creep back.

Maria: small note — one potential gap: I won't be reachable by phone during climb. AJ, can you also nudge support to turn off auto-retries for heavy customers to reduce load? Support contact: @Nora oncall support.

Nora: on it. I'll post a short note to the support rotation to throttle retries for the top 10 enterprise tenants.

oncall-bot: Alert update: EMBEDS_HIGH_LATENCY — severity remains sev2. Assigned primary: AJ, secondary: Maria.

AJ: accepted. I'll keep primary until 02:00 UTC per the rotation, unless handback requested earlier. Maria — have a good flight. I'll update the rotation calendar after this thread and add a sticky note in the incident doc.

Maria: thanks all. One last thing — AJ, please add a short post-incident note with timestamps of the reroutes so we can feed to Optimize for model routing suggestions.

Sam: quick log snippet I grabbed before the reroute in case you need it:
```
[2026-06-12T17:58:12Z] embed-service: downstream 502 from embed-worker-7
[2026-06-12T17:58:13Z] embed-cache: miss rate spiked to 82% for prefix length > 64
```

AJ: got it. I'll close the loop here once metrics stabilize for 15m. If anything changes ping me directly. :thumbsup:

Maria: handing off now. Thread for follow-ups. :airplane:

Nora: thanks, team. I'll coordinate with support and docs.

oncall-bot: Thread note — primary/secondary rotation updated in calendar by AJ.

AJ: last message before I start active monitoring: holding the infra deploy, increased fallback to 50%, cache restart queued if error > 15% for 2 consecutive minutes.

Sam: current status at 18:07 UTC — errors at 6%, latency 420ms. Looks stable.

AJ: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring. Maria — safe flight.

Maria: thanks everyone — closing handoff.
